pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal regions with sharp, high-frequency serrations along the perimeter edges (crenulated margins). Patch size is largest on the upper flank and neck, becoming progressively smaller and more fragmented toward the posterior and ventral regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light cream-colored pathways. Junction nodes are predominantly trivalent and tetravalent across the mid-flank. The pixel thickness of these corridors is relatively consistent but shows narrowing at the posterior and lower-flank transitions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, coarse mane visible along the dorsal neck line. The 1D contour against the sky shows a high-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette with consistent fiber height along the visible segment.

other_distinctive_markers: A complex multi-axial junction of light corridors is visible on the lower-posterior flank, forming a distinct star-like pattern where five separate pathways converge at a single node.
